children: Banon Shay, a director and Chief Technology Officer, reported selling ordinary shares in transactions on September 9 and September 10, 2026. The sales were executed to satisfy tax withholding obligations related to RSU and performance-based RSU vesting and were mandated by the issuer's equity incentive plan. The transactions involved multiple sales at varying prices with weighted average prices reported as $86.5511, $88.0774, $88.2797 and $85.1560 per share across the respective lots. The total sale amount reported across all transactions was $14,035,853. Following the reported transactions, the reporting person directly owns 3,994,770 ordinary shares and indirectly owns 1,554,978 ordinary shares held by a fund for a joint account.
